stages.when: After S1 is processed, before the boss checks the contract.

value.originalExpression: 18 000 zł za całość. Chyba brutto... nie pamiętam dokładnie

anchor.quote: 18 000 zł za całość. Chyba brutto... nie pamiętam dokładnie

memoryChanges.rationale: The amount is certain and recordable; only the basis is uncertain, so it must stay not_specified: 'chyba brutto' is not evidence of brutto.

clarifications.ambiguity: Umowa podpisana na 18 000 zł, ale szef sam mówi „Chyba brutto... nie pamiętam dokładnie” — podstawa kwoty w podpisanej umowie jest jawnie niepewna.
clarifications.asksAbout: Whether the 18 000 contract amount is net or gross.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Record the basis as gross on the strength of 'chyba brutto'.
prohibitedWrites.because: An explicitly uncertain recollection is not a source for a tax basis; never infer VAT.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Record the basis as net either.
prohibitedWrites.because: No basis is established until the contract is checked.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Withhold the amount until the basis is answered.
prohibitedWrites.because: The 18 000 amount is fully supported and must be recorded immediately.

stages.when: After S2 confirms the basis from the contract.

anchor.quote: Sprawdziłem umowę z Wiślanej: 18 000 zł netto

memoryChanges.historyExpectation: The not_specified phase remains visible in history: changing the basis creates a revision rather than rewriting it.
memoryChanges.rationale: The contract check resolves the basis to netto; the amount never changed.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Keep the basis not_specified after the explicit answer.
prohibitedWrites.because: Clear evidence arrived; ignoring it leaves a wrong current state.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Alter the amount while fixing the basis.
prohibitedWrites.because: Only the basis was corrected; 18 000 stands.
